shared_elements: upright rectangular slab/pillar with carving in low relief
registers or bands dividing the surface horizontally
animal forms rendered schematically in profile
justification: Both surfaces are tall upright slabs with low-relief carving organised into stacked horizontal registers, and both include schematic, blocky forms repeated in rows; B's identifiable creatures (a long-necked bird, a quadruped, a serpentine form) have no clear counterpart in A. A is filled entirely with dense rows of small paired square glyph-like signs covering the whole shaft, whereas B depicts discrete large animal figures and a row of loop/bag-like motifs above a zigzag band, so the shared traits amount to little more than register division and relief schematism.
